item.title: River Fox Train provides year-round experiences with immersive rides and seasonal favorites
item.description: Among the upcoming highlights is the Yolo Explorer: The Big Game Train, taking place Sunday, Feb. 8 at 3 p.m. This Super Bowl–themed experience offers two distinct onboard atmospheres. One half of the train will host a Big Game viewing party, while the other features the Old Vine Express wine tasting, with an optional guided painting experience for guests more interested in sipping and creating than watching football.

item.title: Norse Herb Company’s 3rd annual The Portal: Marketplace & Extravaganza set for Feb. 28
item.description: Norse Herb Company and Soul Garden Holistic Healing present the 3rd annual The Portal: Marketplace & Extravaganza history-based event celebrating the California Goldrush and Victorian era. The event will take place on Saturday, Feb. 28, from noon to 5 p.m. in downtown Woodland, on Main Street between College and Second Streets and between First and Bush Streets. The event is free for all ages.

item.title: Winner of the 6th annual First-Bumble Bee-of-the-Year Contest receives prized cup
item.description: In January, Lesley Hamamoto won the prize by being the first to photograph and submit the first bumblebee of the year in the contest. She photographed a black-tailed bumble bee, Bombus melanopygus, nectaring on manzanita on Friday, Jan. 2, at 9:59 a.m. in the UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden.

item.title: Woodland Joint Unified School District hires new I.T. Director Andy Xiong
item.description: According to a WJUSD press release, Xiong began his role with the district in January 2026. He replaces former I.T. Director Tina Burkhardt, who retired last November after 13 years of service to WJUSD students and families.
